name: Absinthe Gallery
description: Full-screen portrait gallery with horizontal sliding cards that flip between a photo with biography and a photo with quote, plus thumbnail dock, arrows, keyboard and swipe navigation.
contents: Heading with title and accent word
One card per item with signature, front photo, name, dates, description, back photo, quote and attribution
Thumbnail strip, previous and next buttons, current signature and page counter
behavior: Click a card to crossfade between front and back
Arrow keys change page, space flips all cards
Progress hairline at top grows with page
Images fall back to initials if they fail to load
editableByProps: All cards, images, text and quotes (quotes accept b and strong tags)

needsCodeEdit.where: article className with h-[74vmin] and w-[74vmin]
onKey function in the keydown useEffect
aria-label attributes on article, nav and buttons

fixed: Adds window keydown listener for arrow keys and space, removed on unmount; space is prevented from scrolling
Fills the viewport (100dvh, full width) with fixed heading, progress bar and bottom dock
Loads Google Fonts through link tags for the four default font families
